dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible on the anterior-mid dorsal surface are several 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey rings. The most prominent structures exhibit high-contrast, well-defined boundaries transitioning from dark-grey exterior to lighter internal centers with visible pixel gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid white pixel clusters, appearing primarily as isolated satellites near the macro-annuli. A higher concentration of smaller, solid-color specks is visible along the lower lateral boundary of the neck area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' rings on the mid-dorsal surface form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented longitudinally along the body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex tessellated or 'map-like' interlocking network of light-colored lines is present at the junction of the neck and head, creating a unique polygonal pixel topology distinct from the circular annuli.
